items.title: Chuck Israels interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2021
items.q: Bill auditioned a drummer I thought was, named Joe Chambers, and I thought this guy’s going to be good.

ctx.x: How did — wow — how did that — did it affect the way you approached the music?

I don’t think so. The first drummer was Paul Motian, who did a good job. I wasn’t completely enamored of his playing but I liked it. You know I didn’t find it very — I didn’t find it very beautiful, just the way he hit the drums. His sound. He was a kind of a vertical drummer. But it was okay and I was glad to be in the band and I don’t think I was thinking critically about it, I just don’t remember being — I don’t remember thinking very much about it at all. It certainly didn’t stop us from playing. The music…
